findings.passage: We charge as much as almost any other state for a new CHL (Concealed Handgun License) [now called LTC] license, or for the renewal thereof. And so my bill says, 'Let's get rid of it.' There's already a ton of exceptions out there, whether it's for military veterans, people over the age of sixty, a lot of different exemptions. And so what I want to say is: All of us deserve an exemption. It's very expensive. This is a Constitutional right, the right of self protection. Society gets a benefit from having licensed CHL holders around, in case bad things were to happen.
findings.note: Radio interview (KFYO) on his bill to remove the state fee for a licence to carry a handgun; he calls carrying a constitutional right.
